dedupe_keys.name: grade and tonnage data for lithium cesium and rubidium pegmatite deposits usgs version 2 0

description: This U.S. Geological Survey data release gives in-situ grade and tonnage for lithium, cesium and rubidium resources in pegmatite deposits worldwide, replacing a 1992 lithium pegmatite compilation that no longer matched how industry defines resources. The ScienceBase page says more than 100 potential pegmatite resources were evaluated and only those delineated in three dimensions were kept; tin and tantalum grades are given for lithium-dominated deposits where available, and two US deposits in North Carolina are included. Files are a deposits CSV, a data dictionary, references, deposits by age, metadata, a readme and a CSV formatted as input to MapMark4 probabilistic simulations of undiscovered deposits. Version 2.0 was revised on 2 June 2026 by Joshua Rosera, Niki Wintzer and Dalton McCaffrey, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0, with global coverage. Caveats: the page says it is not an exhaustive list of prospects, and that users should check deposit types and multi-commodity records before fitting grade and tonnage models. For simulation it supports lithium resource assessments and battery supply chain studies, and gives ready inputs for Monte Carlo estimates of undiscovered lithium. Related catalogue records include the USGS USMIN commodity deposit releases, the USGS Critical mineral deposits of the United States and the EV battery cathode critical mineral flows for 2020.
name: Grade and tonnage data for lithium, cesium and rubidium pegmatite deposits (USGS, version 2.0)
